basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old software developer based in Austin, Texas. I have a keen interest in city-building and strategy games, often spending my weekends optimizing my virtual cities. I'm a night owl, usually online from 10 PM to 2 AM CST. Single and enjoying my time exploring different hobbies like digital art and music production. I like discovering new indie games and am not a fan of FPS games. I'm always on the lookout for new music, hence my recent interest in Smokepurpp.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in computer science and have been working as a front-end developer for the past four years. My love for gaming started at a young age, and I often combine my programming skills with gaming, like creating mods or game tools. Recently, I've been exploring blockchain technology, which led me to subreddits like OpenSea for NFTs.
